text: {"text":"The migration renamed three public fields while retaining compatibility aliases. Of the fourteen known clients, twelve have migrated, while the status of the other two remains unknown. Migrating twelve known clients is substantial progress. At the same time, the integration tests cover those twelve migrated clients, but they do not cover the two clients whose migration status remains unknown. Given that exact boundary, I recommend that we not remove the aliases until the owners of both remaining clients confirm migration. The evidence supports continuing the migration work; it does not support removing the aliases."}
